info.description: The Carrental Reservations Management API facilitates the creation of new car rental reservations. This endpoint allows users to submit reservation requests, providing essential details such as pick-up and drop-off locations, rental dates, and vehicle preferences. Ideal for travel agencies and customers seeking to arrange car rentals seamlessly, this API enhances booking workflows and ensures a smooth reservation experience. By leveraging this API, businesses can efficiently manage customer demand and improve service delivery.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new reservation by providing the necessary details. Ensure that all required fields are filled in to successfully create a reservation.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the details required to create a new reservation. It includes all necessary information such as reservation dates, customer details, and any special requests.
